posts.title: Patch notes: Alpha 0.3.9
posts.excerpt: Now on Unreal Engine 5.9, with Rolling Thunder batteries and flak on capital ships and stations, rebuilt Liberty shipyards with a landing pad, the Freeport 7 opening, new fighters, hangars and a radio with faces.
posts.body:
**New in the game**

*Ships and guns*

- Rolling Thunder: a four-barrel capital battery on the Liberty dreadnoughts, firing salvos barrel by barrel with heavy recoil and slow traverse.
- Every battleship and cruiser carries two four-barrel flak cannons; their shells burst where you will be, forming a barrage.
- Flak bursts flash, throw shrapnel and leave a black, ragged puff of smoke that hangs and swells.
- The Dreadnought carries two Rolling Thunders and eight Lavablade Turrets, firing salvos once the barrels point at your aim.
- Station turrets fire a heavy blue bolt with the original's numbers and sound.
- The Hawk gets a new model, with guns under the wing roots and wings that break off; sold where the original sold it.
- The Banshee, a Rheinland light fighter, gets a new model with glowing red strips and wings that break off.
- The Kusari Drone is rebuilt 32 m long, with twelve cargo bays and the Kusari crest.
- Kusari ships get their own engine look: a bone white jet with a pale vermilion fringe.
- New Nomad fighter (NPCs only) with a flat violet vortex drive; the Nomads' gun fires a magenta-violet bolt.

*Combat*

- Stations are armed: Liberty jump gates, Newark, the shipyards and West Point carry Rolling Thunders, plus turrets on gates, Newark and Trenton.
- NPC turrets fire once they point at their lead.
- Only flak bursts that reach your hull jolt the camera; near misses don't.

*Jobs and missions*

- A lawful character's first play opens with the Freeport 7 scene in Sigma-17; Escape skips it.
- Cutscenes are letterboxed as in the original, wait until ready before playing, and their ships fly with engines and fire.

*Characters and progression*

- Character screen: Trent and Juni stand in the ready room, with a small form beside them for a new character.
- Trent has a new face and a brown leather jacket; Juni is a new figure in dress, stockings and glasses.
- Rosa now wears long wavy hair.

*World*

- Norfolk and Baltimore shipyards are rebuilt: a hub, two arms and two hangars, each holding a Dreadnought or transports.
- Dock at the shipyards on their landing pad: every ship lands there and stands across the deck.
- Norfolk and Baltimore moved in New York to clear their neighbours.
- Atka Research Station has its own hangar: a docking bay with a blast door, labs, stores, workshop and canteen.
- Buffalo Base's hangar is a rougher cave with cables, lanterns, a vault door and a bigger, busier bar.
- Every bar's bartender tells the original's rumours and takes bribes.
- Planet landings start higher, about 1.6 km at Manhattan, so you can dive straight in at cruise.
- Stations and gates have their real sizes: NPCs keep further off big stations, rocks clear further round long ones.
- Loot wrecks are found from 7 km off a station's hull.

*Interface*

- The HUD shows distances to a station's surface, not its centre; Go To stops off the hull.
- Docking control's speaker shows talking in the comm window: Sydney for the women's voices, Walter for the man's.
- All radio talk goes one line at a time: docking control first, then hails, mission voices, combat talk and chatter.

*Graphics and performance*

- The game now runs on Unreal Engine 5.9, the engine's newest version.
- The shipyards render faster, about 3.5 ms less GPU time on the pad view.
- Slightly faster rendering in nebulae; the first visit to a new area may stutter once.

*Sound*

- Rolling Thunder has its own heavy artillery shot; flak cannons and bursts are heard far off, faint and panned.
- A distant barrage no longer drowns out the blasts right next to you.
- Parked ships' engines fade out instead of playing on.

**New and changed in the [wiki](#/wiki)**

- New ship **[Nomad Fighter](#/wiki/ships/nomad-fighter)**: New NPC fighter seen in the Freeport 7 opening, with a flat violet vortex for its drive.
- New ship **[Drone](#/wiki/ships/drone)**: Rebuilt 32 m long with twelve cargo bays, rearranged stern pods, the Kusari crest and the new Kusari engine look.
- New ship **[Hawk](#/wiki/ships/hawk)**: New model with round nozzles, a tinted canopy, HAWK on the nose, guns under the wing roots and breakable wings.
- New ship **[Banshee](#/wiki/ships/banshee)**: New Rheinland light fighter model with glowing red strips, glass canopy panes and wings that break off.
- **[Sigma-17](#/wiki/systems/sigma-17)**: Atka Research Station gets its own hangar: a docking bay with a blast door, then labs, stores, workshop and canteen.
- **[New York](#/wiki/systems/new-york)**: Norfolk and Baltimore shipyards rebuilt with hangars a Dreadnought fits in and a landing pad, and moved clear of neighbours.
- **[Trenton Outpost](#/wiki/stations/trenton-outpost)**: Now guarded by 12 station turrets, no Rolling Thunder.
- **[Newark Station](#/wiki/stations/newark-station)**: Now guarded by four Rolling Thunders and 14 small turrets.
- **[West Point Military Academy](#/wiki/stations/west-point-military-academy)**: Four Rolling Thunders now stand next to its own turrets.
- **[Baltimore Shipyard](#/wiki/stations/baltimore-shipyard)**: Rebuilt yard: land on its pad with ships parked across the deck, four Rolling Thunders, charcoal recesses, faster rendering.

**Bugfixes**

- Women's long hair no longer jitters or flies about in hangars and bars.
- Allies' calls for help and NPC scans are heard on dedicated servers; chatter no longer stops.
- The Dreadnought's turrets aim ahead of the ship with nothing under the cursor, not behind it.
- The Dreadnought no longer has two empty flak slots; they are Lavablade Turrets again.
- Go To no longer aims inside big stations.
- NPC traffic no longer docks inside big stations such as West Point.
- F3 on a planet keeps cruise to the landing instead of dropping it near the end.
- Long station names on hulls are no longer cut short.
- A cutscene's first music cue is no longer dropped.
- The Banshee's hull no longer shows see-through slits under the shoulders.

posts.title: Patch notes: Alpha 0.3.8
posts.excerpt: Dock at the Navy's battleships, land on Kurile, fly the new Texas system, take contracts and leads from bar guests, try photo mode and shoot parts off ships.
posts.body:
**New in the game**

*Ships and guns*

- The Liberty Dreadnought is rebuilt: 935 m in Navy gunmetal and navy, ten turrets, its crest and name on the hull.
- The Defender flies as a Navy ship: the police light bar and police lights are gone, nav lights and strobes stay.
- Ship editor: 34 markings and 45 sticker art decals join the crests; hovering one shows it full size.
- Markings and lettering take your paint colours; type a callsign, hull number or name of up to 16 characters as lettering.

*Combat*

- NPCs fire cruise disruptors after a random delay, and only one or two of them per cruise.
- Nebula interference cuts sensors both ways: contacts, NPC engage range and missile locks; a missile chasing a ship into the cloud loses it.
- Trade lane attacks are about a third as likely: a 30 % lane is now about 10 %.

*Jobs and missions*

- From level 4, bar guests tagged CONTRACT offer elite bounties, wanted men or risky escorts led by a named ace, at about triple pay.
- Bar guests tagged TALK tell rumours, sell information that marks places on your map, and take bribes for better standing.

*Trading and loot*

- Bar guests tagged LEAD sell where a loot wreck lies; the map marks its area, and finding it gives you its cargo.
- Convoys carry real runs: destroying one dents its destination's market; short bases draw more convoys, Manhattan the most.
- Prisoner transports fly with empty bays.

*Characters and progression*

- Each Liberty station seats its own guests in the hangar bar, as many as the original's bar had, dressed in station colours.
- New bar guests Kai and Leon share a booth; Jack gets a face of his own.
- Manhattan's Skyline Lounge fills with 13 guests, many of them Navy officers.
- The cantina at Pittsburgh, and now California Minor, has a bartender, miners and people off shift, different at each base.
- Bar people move more naturally: standing women and Sydney on real idles, longer pauses in talk, patrons gesturing only while speaking.
- The women's figures are reshaped; the Navy deck officer gets her own face and long dark hair, and Lena is a new guest.

*World*

- New system Texas: lanes drop from high gates to Houston, and a black hole swallows wreckage between dark matter jets and radiation.
- Dock at the Navy's battleships (Missouri, Yukon, Mississippi, Rio Grande) through blast doors into a dark warship hangar with a mess.
- Land on Kurile, now one toxic ocean: Samura's rig vents green gas in a stormy green sea under a rolling overcast.
- Kurile now lies hidden deep in Kunashir's cloud, its clouds dimmed by the gas; near it you see 1-2 km.
- Manhattan is a city world with amber night lights; Los Angeles is mostly ocean, Mojave a desert, Maine a new ice world.
- California Minor is an icy world whose lava glows orange through its valleys at night.
- Sigma-17 has a green nebula sky, California a cold blue one.
- Sigma-17, California and New York gain height: regions, planets, gates and holes kilometres above or below, lanes climbing to them.
- The Blue Dwarf's disc fades into thick dust up close instead of looking blocky.
- Tahoe's crystal field lies in fog banks of varying thickness instead of clear patches and white-outs.
- Radiation, sensor interference, drag, mine and volatile gas zones work as in the original, with the Neural Net's warnings.
- Atka Research Station is remade: a glass dome with a garden, a turning wheel and Cryer's crest; dock into a Liberty hangar.
- Liberty hangars wear their owner's colours and crest, industrial bases a darker industrial look; the reception and ready room are rearranged.
- Trade lane rings show green lamps where you enter and red the other way; all red when disrupted.
- Liberty lane rings in LPI's charcoal and gunmetal; Navy weapon platforms, West Point and Willard in gunmetal and navy.
- Owner crests on Trenton, the Orbital Station, Willard and West Point.
- Storage depots are rebuilt: framed boxes open on bays of stacked containers, with their name and owner's crest.
- Space props and depots wear their owner's livery; ownerless ones a plain industrial grey.
- New York's lawful traders, patrols and guards fly their routes all the time, busiest around Manhattan.

*Interface*

- Photo mode (P or the Esc menu): free camera, filters, depth of field, cinema bars; saves PNGs and pauses single player.
- The ship editor takes the right half of the window beside the ship, with PAINT, ENGINES, DECALS and NAME AND LIVERY tabs.
- Hazard chips at the top left: RADIATION blinks, SENSORS REDUCED and others while you are in a zone.
- Join the crew! in the Esc and start menus, with the latest backers' names there and on the loading screen.
- 13 new loading screen pictures.

*Graphics and performance*

- No more freezes when traffic ships appear: their engines, crests and cargo now load smoothly.
- Starting a save landed at a planet takes about 16 s instead of 28.
- Liberty hangars run about twice as fast, with no shadows missing at High.
- Effects no longer recompile at every load and landing, saving seconds.
- Tahoe's comet tails cost half as much, so fights there run smoother.
- The lane ride tunnel bends with the lane instead of pointing straight off the curve.
- Station lamps far off show as small dots instead of big blobs.

*Sound*

- The cruise charge sound fits each class's charge time: a little higher on light ships, deeper on heavies.

*Multiplayer*

- A CONNECTION LAG chip shows when the server goes quiet or lags.

**New and changed in the [wiki](#/wiki)**

- New ship **[Liberty Dreadnought](#/wiki/ships/liberty-dreadnought)**: A 935 m hull in Navy gunmetal with navy bands, lit windows, ten turrets, the crest and name, two berths to dock.
- New system **[Sigma-17](#/wiki/systems/sigma-17)**: Land on Kurile: Samura's rig in a stormy green sea with swell up to 3.5 m, under a low rolling overcast.
- New system **[Texas](#/wiki/systems/texas)**: Dark and eerie: a black hole at West Dallas swallows wreckage between dark matter jets, with green radiation gas and new planets.
- New weapon **[Carillon](#/wiki/weapons/carillon)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Talon](#/wiki/weapons/talon)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Donner](#/wiki/weapons/donner)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Proximity Mine Dropper](#/wiki/weapons/proximity-mine-dropper)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[EMP Mine Dropper](#/wiki/weapons/emp-mine-dropper)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Singularity Mine Dropper](#/wiki/weapons/singularity-mine-dropper)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Hanabi](#/wiki/weapons/hanabi)**: Now in the wiki.
- New station **[Atka Research Station](#/wiki/stations/atka-research-station)**: Now in the wiki.
- New station **[Battleship Missouri](#/wiki/stations/battleship-missouri)**: Dock through two berths behind swinging blast door leaves into the Navy's own warship hangar, its blast door bearing the Navy's crest.
- **[Rhino](#/wiki/ships/rhino)**: New in-game shots.
- **[Starflier](#/wiki/ships/starflier)**: New in-game shots.
- **[Defender](#/wiki/ships/defender)**: Now a Navy ship in gunmetal and navy, the Navy's crest on nose and wings; police light bar and lights gone.
- **[Startracker](#/wiki/ships/startracker)**: New in-game shots.
- **[Patriot](#/wiki/ships/patriot)**: New in-game shots.
- **[Piranha](#/wiki/ships/piranha)**: New in-game shots.
- **[Transport](#/wiki/ships/transport)**: New in-game shots.
- **[Large Transport](#/wiki/ships/large-transport)**: New in-game shots.
- **[Dagger](#/wiki/ships/dagger)**: New in-game shots.
- **[Wolfhound](#/wiki/ships/wolfhound)**: New in-game shots.
- **[Mule](#/wiki/ships/mule)**: New in-game shots.
- **[Bloodhound](#/wiki/ships/bloodhound)**: New in-game shots.
- **[Dromedary](#/wiki/ships/dromedary)**: New in-game shots.
- **[Valkyrie](#/wiki/ships/valkyrie)**: New in-game shots.
- **[Barracuda](#/wiki/ships/barracuda)**: New in-game shots.
- **[California](#/wiki/systems/california)**: Tahoe's crystal field now lies in real fog, banks thick and thin, so its rocks fade into it even from outside.
- **[Trenton Outpost](#/wiki/stations/trenton-outpost)**: In Universal Shipping's livery: gunmetal, black trim and freight orange, its crest on both flanks of each berth sleeve.
- **[Newark Station](#/wiki/stations/newark-station)**: In Interspace Commerce's livery with cleanly painted panels and its crest under the IC sign; no white lumps, blot or gold flecks.
- **[West Point Military Academy](#/wiki/stations/west-point-military-academy)**: In the Navy's gunmetal and navy with black trim, no white; the Navy's crests on its ring deck.
- **[Willard Research Station](#/wiki/stations/willard-research-station)**: Now in the Navy's livery, with the crest on its ring section; its lamps far off are smaller and dimmer.
- **[Orbital Station](#/wiki/stations/orbital-station)**: Wears its owner's livery and crest on an engine tank: LPI's at Manhattan, DSE's worn harder at Pittsburgh, Planetform's.
- **[Baltimore Shipyard](#/wiki/stations/baltimore-shipyard)**: Its hull's windows now show as dark glass instead of a blank material.

**Bugfixes**

- Ship parts break off under fire on every ship; a hull repair at a base brings them back.
- Homing missiles hit again: NPCs drop far fewer flares.
- Carillon missiles hit about 50 % harder.
- Mines reach farther, move faster and lead their target, so they catch passing fighters.
- Heavy fighters turn as fast as in the original.
- Wreck pieces look solid and torn, charred with glowing cracks, not hollow or one lava sheet.
- Target brackets sit on the ship, not on its contrails.
- NPC ships, lane rings and wrecks frost over in icy gas like your ship.
- The mission commander waits for docking control to finish speaking.
- Clicking a loot row ticks or unticks the crate.
- LAUNCH NOW cuts to the pad through black instead of the slow hangar glide.
- Missile launch sounds are no louder than the guns.
- Liberty landing pads play the original's music again.
- Manhattan's bar no longer hears the traffic's engines outside.
- Distant ships' lamps are tiny points, not blobs bigger than the ship.
- Aim cursor has a dark rim and a colour choice in Options, readable on bright planets and hulls.
- Ships on Manhattan's pad no longer fly through the camera.
- No more crash when launching from a planet pad.
- Skipping a landing or docking shows the loading screen until the base has loaded.
- Planet clouds and jump holes no longer show through nebula gas from beyond the sun.
- Kurile's clouds no longer turn black when you fly in through Kunashir.
- Women's long hair no longer jumps or flies over their heads.
- Bar guests talk to the person across from them, not into empty seats.
- Martha and Nora no longer stand on air or drop when gesturing.
- Sydney no longer slides across the floor with every nod and wave.
- Skin no longer shows through the back of the women's boots up close.
- Junko Zane's grey top no longer shows under her dress.
- Sigma-17's extra suns no longer light the hangar bar through its walls.
- No red warning in rooms with ray tracing switched off.
- Named pilots carry the right title for their level: Rookie, Veteran, Ace; Off., Lt., Cmdr.
- Station and shipyard windows show dark glass instead of a blank material.
- Newark Station's hull no longer shows white lumps, a black blot or gold flecks.

posts.title: Patch notes: Alpha 0.3.7
posts.excerpt: Missiles reworked into four types, new thruster types, weapon platforms and West Point that fight back, smarter NPC wings, new asteroid fields and a reworked Sigma-17.
posts.body:
**New in the game**

*Ships and guns*

- New thruster types in Mk I–V: Burst (strong but thirsty), Marathon (economical) and Vector (better strafing and turning while burning).
- Missiles reworked: no lock-on step, and R fires every launcher aboard at once.
- Four missile types: homing Talon (Stalker line), ballistic Carillon (Organ line), swarm Hanabi (Circus line), EMP Donner (Static line).
- Talon missiles fly straight briefly, then home with a wider seeker; Carillons fly straight and fast; Hanabi rounds fire six rockets.
- Donner EMP hits strip shields: two hits empty a light fighter's shield of the same mark.
- Launchers fit gun mounts by mark: Mk I–II small, III–IV medium, Mk V large for heavy fighters.
- Missile launchers have their own models that turn and aim like turrets, and each missile type has its own look in flight.
- The Defender now carries Liberty Navy lettering and Liberty's crest on its wings and nose.
- Place up to eight faction crests anywhere on your hull in the Ship Editor; other players see them.
- REPAIR HULL at the outfitter fixes your damaged ship for a price.

*Combat*

- Weapon platforms now fight hostile ships with turrets and missiles, can be destroyed, and return after 30 minutes.
- New designs for Liberty's big weapon platform, the small eight-turret platform and pirate asteroid platforms.
- Liberty's big platform carries four extra gun turrets and twice the hull.
- Destroyed platforms blow up in a huge blast and break into burning wreckage that stays.
- West Point's turrets and missiles fire on hostile ships and anyone who shoots it; the station can't be destroyed.
- Turrets on platforms and NPC ships only fire where their barrels can point, not through their own hull.
- NPC wings focus hurt enemies, flank, cover damaged wingmen and pick a new leader when theirs falls.
- Open-world NPC wings can break and flee; Police and Navy wings call in reinforcements.
- NPC fighters now bank into hard turns and fly level otherwise, instead of fighting on their side.
- Losing hull in a fight now wears down your mounted equipment.

*Jobs and missions*

- Each character gets their own job board, and taking a job rolls a fresh board.

*Trading and loot*

- The nav map shows a base's market and the system's best known prices, live with Market Contacts.

*World*

- New space props at triple size: tank rows and crosses, Detroit's Communications Satellite, wrecks, storage depots, ice crystals.
- Asteroid fields have new, lighter rocks, each a slightly different tone.
- The Badlands are a forest of black rock shards up to 700 m; Tahoe has ice crystals.
- A 1 km rock spire stands between Pittsburgh and Maine; four ice rocks surround Willard Research Station.
- All rocks stay sharp up close at any size.
- Sigma-17 gets its own look: three suns, new nebulae Kunashir and Nemuro, and Kurile as an island ocean world.
- New nav, hazard and race buoys across the universe.
- Liberty stations, trade lanes and the Liberty jump gate get a warm off-white livery without gold; Trenton matches West Point.
- The LSF crest hangs on Manhattan's tower, and Liberty's crest replaces the gold star in Liberty rooms.
- Base room people move with lifelike motion, look around, blink and talk to each other with moving faces.
- The flight instructor stands like a navy officer; six new bar guests; the bartender wears a waistcoat suit.
- Manhattan's Navy officers wear officer uniforms.

*Interface*

- Pictures for droppers, thrusters, mines, nanobots, shield batteries and missiles; empty loadout slots show a dimmed picture.
- New pictures on the base screen, flight menu, outfitter, shipyard and start menu buttons.
- Outfitter shows stats by item kind, compares only like items, shows infocards and scrolls.
- Launchers and missiles show their type and a colour in inventory, outfitter, hangar and the flight HUD.
- Storage lists ammo for your current ship first; after a sale the next cargo item is picked.
- The lock-on marker on targets is gone; your selected target is the lock.
- Click waypoint markers to target them, then use Go To to fly there.
- Report bugs, send feedback or report a player from the Flight Menu.
- The loading screen stays up until the system is ready and shows a title card and new pictures.
- The start menu shows Manhattan, Trenton Outpost and the ice ring star, with traffic flying by.
- New Graphics option: All stars, or only the stars visible to the naked eye.
- Ship Editor: the engines' and crests' button reads BACK TO THE PAINT while open.

*Graphics and performance*

- Station, buoy and ship lights glow visibly from far away.
- Sharper sun shadows at Medium and High quality.
- Lighter missile blasts; the Donner bursts in a red EMP pulse, and jammed hulls crackle red.
- NPC guns recoil when they fire.
- Faster docking bay: bar guests are only drawn when the bar is in view.
- The character screen no longer renders the ready room continuously.

*Sound*

- The Hanabi launcher fires with a cannon shot, and its rockets whoosh as they fly off.

**New and changed in the [wiki](#/wiki)**

- New ship **[Piranha](#/wiki/ships/piranha)**: Now in the wiki.
- New ship **[Transport](#/wiki/ships/transport)**: Now in the wiki.
- New ship **[Large Transport](#/wiki/ships/large-transport)**: Now in the wiki.
- New ship **[Dagger](#/wiki/ships/dagger)**: Now in the wiki.
- New ship **[Wolfhound](#/wiki/ships/wolfhound)**: Now in the wiki.
- New ship **[Mule](#/wiki/ships/mule)**: Now in the wiki.
- New ship **[Bloodhound](#/wiki/ships/bloodhound)**: Now in the wiki.
- New ship **[Dromedary](#/wiki/ships/dromedary)**: Now in the wiki.
- New ship **[Valkyrie](#/wiki/ships/valkyrie)**: Now in the wiki.
- New ship **[Barracuda](#/wiki/ships/barracuda)**: Now in the wiki.
- New system **[Sigma-17](#/wiki/systems/sigma-17)**: Its own look, and several suns per system.
- New weapon **[Barrager](#/wiki/weapons/barrager)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Scrapstorm](#/wiki/weapons/scrapstorm)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Azrael](#/wiki/weapons/azrael)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Vassago](#/wiki/weapons/vassago)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Exorcist](#/wiki/weapons/exorcist)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Reaper](#/wiki/weapons/reaper)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Scorpion](#/wiki/weapons/scorpion)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Tarantula](#/wiki/weapons/tarantula)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Lavablade](#/wiki/weapons/lavablade)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Starbeam](#/wiki/weapons/starbeam)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Stunpulse](#/wiki/weapons/stunpulse)**: Now in the wiki.
- **[Defender](#/wiki/ships/defender)**: Defender as the Liberty Navy's, Liberty's national crest on its wings and nose.
- **[California](#/wiki/systems/california)**: California's layout map.
- **[Orbital Station](#/wiki/stations/orbital-station)**: Rebuilt Trenton, the orbital station, Liberty's trade lane ring, the berth doors and Willard without gold.
- No longer in the wiki (stations): New York –> California.

posts.title: How I make a new Ship in 2 hours using AI
posts.excerpt: With proper systems you can get new ships into your game in hours!
posts.body:
I've recently been asked what my workflow for adding new ships is.

I have been a dev in my day job for 20 years, so EVERYTHING is systems based. Especially with AI this is ABSOLUTELY necessary :)

This is taken straight from Discord.

# The Workflow
Say the Drone Freighter for Kusari (which isnt in yet).

This was the prompt in Tripo AI (which used chatGPT image generation):
"Create a cool japanese style freighter space ship. Not a huge hauler. Medium sized. Visible cargo. Make the wings look like dragon wings or something"

Then I had it created like 8-16 different images. Lots of them are ass, so you gotta go with numbers.

![](images/uploads/2026-11-08-image-mw7n7ucb.jpg)

Then I pick one and tell Tripo to render it as a 3D model.

Now this is a shitshow because its guessing a lot from the image. You can add different angles, so sometimes I ask grok to give me different angles of the reference ship. Sometimes it works right away
I chose this:

![](images/uploads/2026-11-08-image-2-mw7n8c33.jpg)

It then creates multiple versions of this in wireframe 3D. Many of them suck or have tons of holes. So its a numbers game again until you find a good one

![](images/uploads/2026-11-08-image-mw7n8snz.jpg)

This is the result.
Now this has still a tons of bugs at this point. And this is where I have created by trial and error, a 9 step part for Claude.AI to go over the model, look for holes with a magenta background. Mirror starboard to portside or vice versa if its asymmetrical. Remove unnecessary stuff and place guns yourself.

Then it goes for the textures, removing AI scriblles, fixing issues, and building multiple layers for liveries and decals as well as the frost in ice clouds 
Sometimes these are wrong, so I need to place them myself, or tell the AI where to do it
So through try and error, eventually you get to a ship that looks good. I check it then ingame. Tell the AI to fix things, etc

# SYSTEMS, EVERYWHERE

You see, ive been a dev for 20 years, so EVERYTHING is systems based.

I have developed systems for the ships, the systems, the guns, the suns, the planets. All of it follows an outlined system the AI just works with

Which is again, where I say, AI doesnt solve your issues, it just makes your work a lot faster
But with this I can basically get a ship into the game within roughly 3-4 hours fully playable
which is still insane

I did the same for weapon platforms or even big planetsized rocks which I recently added. Although for those we use texture tiling, because the tripo 4k texture gets stretched a lot otherwise

Now for capital ships, its a whole nother work. You will have to split it up into multiple parts. THats how I made the NPC Transport ship which is massive. Front, center, and back, each done differently in Tripo, otherwise the textures get blurry af.

Then stitched together.

Took me a whole day for this one, but wurth it

![](images/uploads/2026-11-08-screenshot-20261108-105002-mw7niuuv.jpg)

posts.title: Patch notes: Alpha 0.3.6
posts.excerpt: Pirate start: begin unlawful at Buffalo Base. Redesigned Mule, Bloodhound, Dromedary, Valkyrie and Barracuda, custom engine colours, patrol scans of pirates, and multiplayer leaderboards.
posts.body:
**New in the game**

*Ships and guns*

- Mule redesigned: new hull, glass canopy, four exhausts that fill their openings, MULE and crest on the nose.
- Mule now has 3750 hull, 150 cargo hold, 20 bots and batteries, and Rochester sells it too.
- Bloodhound redesigned, with FACTORY pirate paint or plain gunmetal UNFLAGGED livery and glowing red lamps.
- Dromedary redesigned as the Zoners' civilian freighter, with cargo stacked in side bays.
- Valkyrie redesigned as a 25 m Rheinland heavy fighter, with recessed exhausts and louvred intake vents.
- Rheinland ships get long deep-red engine flames with lightning crackling round them.
- Barracuda redesigned at its original 18 m length, with wingtip lights and BARRACUDA on the prongs.
- Wolfhound gets new intake fans and a ring of amber lamps in each duct that brighten with throttle.
- Pick each ship's engine design and its colours in flight and cruise in the hangar's Ship Editor.
- Cargo carried on the hull fills its bays far better, so a full hold shows many more crates.
- Countermeasure droppers are now Mirage Mk I, II and III, firing Mirage Flare Mk I, II and III.

*Combat*

- Flares now divert cruise disruptors as well as missiles. Torpedoes ignore flares.

- Lawful patrols hostile to you scan your hold before firing and order it dropped. Refusing or fleeing means a fight.
- If you drop your cargo they spare you for two minutes, but now and then they attack anyway.
- Bounty hunters always attack on sight. Patrols attack ships with empty holds without scanning.

*Characters and progression*

- Choose a lawful or unlawful start when creating a character. The story is played as lawful.
- Unlawful start: docked at Buffalo Base in a Starflier, friendly with Rogues and Lane Hackers, wanted by the navies.

*Interface*

- The Trader shows the selected good's picture on its card.

- Shields show a picture of their type: a dome for Bulwark, a hex plate for Flux, a shell for Deflector.

*Sound*

- The Neural Net now announces when your cruise is disrupted.

*Multiplayer*

- The system map shows who first found a jump hole or loot wreck, and when.

posts.title: Patch notes: Alpha 0.3.5
posts.excerpt: Escort and hold-the-line jobs, a level earned by flying with perks, a full loot overhaul, Manhattan's city surface, and new ship and gun models.
posts.body:
**New in the game**

*Ships and guns*

- The Patriot has a new police model with a police light bar, strobes and glass canopy.
- The Defender is now 22 m long, with a navy-and-gold LSF livery, cleaner nose line and crest.
- The Startracker's boom strips glow cleanly, and it has one rectangular afterburner nozzle with a matching flame.
- The Piranha is redesigned, with glass side windows, PIRANHA markings and teal engines.
- The Dagger is redesigned, with a pirate factory livery, a plain gunmetal look and dark orange Ember engines.
- The Wolfhound is redesigned, with turning intake fans and Ember engines.
- Transports are redesigned in small and large versions, with honeycomb intakes and ten teal ring engines.
- Freighters and Transports now show their cargo in their bays: containers, crates, tanks or gas.
- New models for the Justice, Starbeam, Lavablade, Stunpulse, Azrael, Barrager, Death's Hand, Reaper and Scorpion.
- Guns carry a glowing level light: blue for low marks, amber for higher marks, red for signature Epics.
- The Starbeam, Lavablade, Azrael, Death's Hand, Reaper and Scorpion fire bolts of their own; the Barrager fires the Starbeam's.
- The Stunpulse crackles with constant lightning between its claws.
- Each gun line has one name with marks counted straight through, such as Justice Mk I to V.
- Each faction's signature Epic is its line's top mark with its own name, such as Vengeance.
- Mark pips show a gun's mark in the outfitter and inventory.
- Turrets carry their line's gun on a base in that gun's colour.
- Player guns and turrets have new infocards describing their family, turret role and signature drops.
- The 15 Legendary story guns each have their own trait, from Chain lightning and Spreading fire to Judgement.
- The hangar's new SHIP EDITOR combines livery, paint and a worn or clean finish, with a live preview.
- Name your ship in the SHIP EDITOR; the name shows in the hangar, dealers, inventory and to other players.
- NPC ships now show their hull lettering and the crest of the faction flying them.
- Ship class badges have new crest artwork.

*Combat*

- Shooting a friendly ship builds its anger: past a warning, its whole group turns on you.
- Groups that like you, and also like a ship you fight, now take a side, with radio calls.
- NPC fighters choose maneuvers from their ship's own tactics: buzzing, trailing, strafing, evading and engine kills.
- NPC aim follows a new accuracy cone, with no aim error against a nearly still ship.
- Mines reworked: they arm in half a second, last 4 minutes, drift toward enemies and survive stray bolts.
- New mine types: EMP mines jam and stop cruise, Singularity mines pull ships into a black hole.
- Mines have a new spiked model with lights that glow by mine type.
- Freighters carry twice as many mines.
- Ship explosions now match the size of the ship.
- Dying wears every item mounted on your ship by 20 condition points.

*Jobs and missions*

- New job: Escort a convoy to another base, even through gates to California; raids come along the way.
- New job: Hold the line, defending a stranded convoy against waves of raiders.
- Escorts and held lines pay by the share of the convoy that survives.
- Mission commander, convoy captain and raid leader speak voiced lines in the comm window.
- Jobs now come in 2-3 waves; the next wave arrives when the last is nearly down.
- In assassination jobs, the target leads the last wave.
- Jobs farther from the base pay up to double.
- Pay now rises properly with a job's danger.
- Leave a battle by over 15 km and a 20-second countdown starts before the job fails.
- The mission commander gives objectives and battle calls, and announces each job's result.
- A completed job shows a VICTORY screen with the paying faction's crest, pay and giver.
- Map job bar: SET COURSE, ABORT MISSION, and LAUNCH NOW when docked; the job waypoint stays marked.
- Routes re-plan from where your ship is, always marking the next lane ring, gate or goal.
- Jobs above your level drop more and better loot, shown as OUTRANKED on the board.
- Job board cards are larger, with the giver's crest and the job kind's crest.
- The job board shows each job's waves, level range and distance.
- Job dealers show a briefcase icon instead of a gun.

*Trading and loot*

- Loot crates look their rarity, from cargo boxes to glowing capsules; Epic drops nearby get a banner.
- Epic and Legendary crates are sealed: get within 500 m and hold the beam 3 seconds.
- Tap B for a loot overlay listing crates by rarity and value, with tractor, scrap and never-take options.
- Hold B to take the best loot in range until the hold is full.
- Set which rarities to collect automatically, and items to never take, in Options or the loot overlay.
- Equipment and ammo now take hold space.
- Scrap equipment and ammo into scrap metal, from your hold or a crate in range.
- Looted equipment comes damaged and works worse until repaired; dealers pay less for it.
- New REPAIR button at dealers restores items to full condition.
- Legendaries drop only rarely from kills; your chance grows with each kill since the last one.
- Every drop is rarer the higher its rarity.
- Loot from kills is personal: each player who helped gets their own crates.
- 41 new smuggled trade goods, mostly sold and bought at pirate bases and Freeports.
- Six new Epic contraband goods come only as loot from pirates, Zoners and loot wrecks.
- Traffic freighters carry goods their routes trade, and drop them when destroyed.
- Every commodity now has its own picture, and gun tiles show the gun's picture.
- Item tiles are tinted by rarity.
- The outfitter's BUY puts gear into the cargo bay when no slot is free.

*Characters and progression*

- Your level is now earned by flying: kills, jobs, trade profit and discoveries, worth more in dangerous places.
- At levels 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25, pick one of three utility perks in Player Status.
- Perks include Long Tractor, Thrifty Repairs, Insured Hold, Salvager, Diplomat, Well Connected and more.
- A flight instructor in Liberty stations' docking bays swaps a perk for 2,000 credits per level.
- The character screen is now a pilots' ready room, with Juni standing there in 3D.
- New pilots start landed on Planet Manhattan.
- A banner announces when your standing with a faction turns hostile, neutral or friendly.
- Player Status shows changed factions on top, with crests beside each faction.
- Story-only factions no longer appear in the reputation list.
- Single player now runs entirely on your PC with its own saves; multiplayer characters are separate.

*World*

- Manhattan's surface is a full city, with a spaceport landing pad and an evening sky.
- Ships stream through lanes among Manhattan's towers.
- Manhattan's spaceport hub and a skyscraper block are Liberty white, with a Liberty star by the pad.
- The Skyline Lounge now stands on a Manhattan rooftop, with the city outside its windows.
- The Tahoe nebula in California is now wispy, see-through pale ice instead of a solid white cloud.
- NPC traffic now spawns zone by zone, filling the area as you launch, jump in or leave a lane.
- New York's lawful traffic is three times busier, with no more pirates.
- Trade lane rings can be disrupted, stopping rides and dropping ships out halfway.
- Hostile groups may ambush trade lanes, draining a ring's shield ahead of you.
- Dropping out of a lane now brakes and turns your ship off the lane.
- Trade lane rings glow in their faction's colour.
- Republican Shipping is now Rheinland Empire Shipping.
- Every faction now has a crest.

*Interface*

- The start menu offers NEW GAME, LOAD GAME, MULTIPLAYER, OPTIONS and EXIT.
- The start menu view looks down past Newark, its shadow cutting a sunbeam through the dust.
- The Flight Menu has a Main Menu option to switch pilot, save or realm.
- Planet landings and launches can be skipped with SKIP or Esc.
- The idle cinematic camera keeps playing in trade lanes and while docking.
- New system map filters mark bases with job boards or flight instructors.

*Graphics and performance*

- Options adds a Ray tracing switch; ray tracing now runs only with global illumination at High or Epic.
- Graphics quality now has four levels, Low to Epic.
- Quality presets now also scale fields, debris and nebulae.
- On first start, the game picks a quality preset and render scale to suit your PC.
- Nebulae run faster and use less graphics memory below Epic.
- Graphics memory use is lower everywhere.
- Engine exhausts now run only when visible, making the start menu and busy systems much faster.
- Distant engines, contrails and ship movement are cheaper, so big fights run much smoother.
- Countermeasure flares and missile trails cost far less, so fights with many flares stay smooth.
- Tractor beam, jump gate and teleport effects are cheaper and show their proper colours.
- Tractor beams glow in the crate's rarity colour.
- Trade lane ring effects no longer show a hard inner edge.
- Engines now light their own ship's hull, fins and wings, with shadows.
- Hull frost is reworked, with feathered edges and crystals, and now covers Rhino cargo containers.

*Sound*

- New afterburner sound.
- The start menu plays one of three menu tracks at random.
- Job results play victory or failure music; job pay plays the money sound.
- Escort and hold-the-line voices speak in their faction's accent, with a radio tone.

*Multiplayer*

- Jumps between servers no longer reload: the next system builds seamlessly under the jump vortex.
- PLAY joins your system's server directly and faster.
- The whole realm sees a banner when someone finds a Legendary.
- Looted wrecks stay looted even after a server restarts.

**New and changed in the [wiki](#/wiki)**

- New ship **[Startracker](#/wiki/ships/startracker)**: Boom strips' glow drawn from their slots' shape, one rectangular afterburner nozzle in place of the four small ports.
- New ship **[Patriot](#/wiki/ships/patriot)**: Patriot from the new police model.
- New ship **[Piranha](#/wiki/ships/piranha)**: The Piranha redesigned.
- New ship **[Transport](#/wiki/ships/transport)**: The companies' utility transport, 104 m, NPC only.
- New ship **[Large Transport](#/wiki/ships/large-transport)**: Now in the wiki.
- New ship **[Dagger](#/wiki/ships/dagger)**: The Dagger redesigned, with its two paints as liveries.
- New ship **[Wolfhound](#/wiki/ships/wolfhound)**: The Wolfhound redesigned, its intake fans turning.
- New weapon **[Barrager](#/wiki/weapons/barrager)**: The Junkers' gatling, the whole turret in one model.
- New weapon **[Scrapstorm](#/wiki/weapons/scrapstorm)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Azrael](#/wiki/weapons/azrael)**: The Liberty Rogues' laser, a small mount on the Justice's base in its paint.
- New weapon **[Vassago](#/wiki/weapons/vassago)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Exorcist](#/wiki/weapons/exorcist)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Reaper](#/wiki/weapons/reaper)**: The Order's neutron cannon, the whole turret in one model, its turret line on its own base, the gun alone the barrel without it.
- New weapon **[Scorpion](#/wiki/weapons/scorpion)**: The Xenos' particle cannon, spiked black-rust armour with a scorpion's tail over its back, a gun alone on a medium mount, on the Justice's base in its paint.
- New weapon **[Tarantula](#/wiki/weapons/tarantula)**: Now in the wiki.
- New weapon **[Lavablade](#/wiki/weapons/lavablade)**: Liberty's heavy plasma gun, a large mount, its lava glowing.
- New weapon **[Starbeam](#/wiki/weapons/starbeam)**: The Starbeam's own model, and a turret base per gun line in that gun's colour.
- New weapon **[Stunpulse](#/wiki/weapons/stunpulse)**: The police EMP gun, a medium mount on the Justice's base in its paint.
- **[Rhino](#/wiki/ships/rhino)**: Patriot canopy panes as glass, the Rhino rebuilt, a new pilot starts landed on Manhattan.
- **[Starflier](#/wiki/ships/starflier)**: The Starflier's chin gun hangs turned over.
- **[Defender](#/wiki/ships/defender)**: The Defender's wing guns hang turned over.
- **[Death's Hand](#/wiki/weapons/death-s-hand)**: The Order's laser, a long black blade, a small mount on the Justice's base in its paint.
- **[Justice](#/wiki/weapons/justice)**: The Justice 30 % bigger, and an item's rarity in its tile's ground, not only its edge.

**Bugfixes**

- Outfitter: sell loot straight out of the hold.
- Headlights light what is ahead.
- Nebula volume shadow: no gas behind the sun casts.
- Small issues: docking shot, planet view after a rebuild, NPC deaths.
- Ship collision: players bump into NPC and player ships.
- No default post-material frame at a jump's or landing's start.
- Outfitter: storage on the right, the cargo bay in the slots' list.
- Escape pod jobs: no sign-off at the tractor, the result after the landing.
- Guns follow the cursor only in mouse flight.

A lot has happened, so here are the updates.

What changed in the [wiki](#/wiki):

- New system **[California](#/wiki/systems/california)**: Sun per system: New York's round warm sun back, California keeps its own (issue #331).
- New station **[West Point Military Academy](#/wiki/stations/west-point-military-academy)**: West Point: baked from Alex's further layout edits.
- New station **[Buffalo Base](#/wiki/stations/buffalo-base)**: Rock hangar: the pirates' docking bay cut into an asteroid, first Buffalo Base's.
- New station **[Willard Research Station](#/wiki/stations/willard-research-station)**: Buffalo Base's asteroid base design on ice, the Buffalo build made one tool for every asteroid base.
- New station **[New York –> California](#/wiki/stations/new-york-california)**: Jump vortex: the blue and black clouds stream three times as fast, smeared over a 60th of a second; the white core keeps its pace.
- New station **[Baltimore Shipyard](#/wiki/stations/baltimore-shipyard)**: Liberty shipyard: Norfolk and Baltimore Shipyard rebuilt with two dreadnought construction bays.
- **[Rhino](#/wiki/ships/rhino)**: The under-nose turret moves onto the nose's spine plate between the forward guns.
- **[Starflier](#/wiki/ships/starflier)**: Starflier lettering as decals: sharp at any distance; Tripo's lettering painted out smoothly.
- **[Defender](#/wiki/ships/defender)**: Hull plating on the navy underside, each navy panel its own shade.
- **[Trenton Outpost](#/wiki/stations/trenton-outpost)**: Trenton Outpost with 2 bays: the middle row's ends (01 the player's, 02 NPC traffic's), the other ends capped.
- **[Newark Station](#/wiki/stations/newark-station)**: Body made symmetric (Tripo's crumpled recess gone), lettering as decals after the infocard, the old Newark leftovers removed.
- **[Orbital Station](#/wiki/stations/orbital-station)**: Lamp housings in plain paint; Orbital Station and trade lane rings rebuilt at full detail.

Various bugfixes.

posts.title: Multiple Ships, Liveries, and redoing it all again
posts.excerpt: Redoing the Starflier, Rhino and Defender, and multiple ships hangar!
posts.body:
# Never enough...

I have this issue that when I do something I demand absolute perfection from myself (and others (the AI lol)) and while it helps with details, it's not a healthy way to go about things :D

Either way, the closest to "perfect" I could've gotten was with Tripo AI modelling which turns images into wireframe models (textured) which I can then port 1:1 into the game.

Hence why now have the new Starflier:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-21-c02340c4-a134-4d0c-85c4-caec41025b44-mvi5j6v6.jpg)

New Rhino:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-21-image-mvi5jnqr.jpg)

And currently rebuilding the Defender:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-21-de60ae2b-6848-4444-a072-e3d82be5bfba-mvi5k7xy.jpg)

Ingame shots in the wiki soon.

Now I wanna redo the stations... man, it's not healthy :D

## Hangars, Multiple Ships and Liveries

Yes, you heard that right, multiple ships being owned will be possible. Well, it already is implemented :D Not a dream, it's already working.

With a storage where you can keep guns and cargo and whatnot.

![](images/uploads/2026-10-21-image-mvi5t2bn.jpg)

Icons are placeholders for now.

![](images/uploads/2026-10-21-image-mvi5tml2.jpg)


![](images/uploads/2026-10-21-image-mvi5u1hw.jpg)
Still gotta fix the nebulas in this one!


I also wanna put more effort into the trading system of the game because I thought the original lacked this a bit.

What else happened:
* Liveries for each ship per player are possible and already work (eventually I wanna add an editor so you can make em yourself)
* Player storage MMO baseline for the servers works
* NPC combat is in
* Friendly NPCs
* Redid the Trade lane VFX
* Missiles, torpedos, shields, all added to the game (no visuals yet)
* Main menu with graphics settings etc
* Redid the badlands nebula (again)
* Lots of bugfixes

posts.title: 0.2.1 we have a working New York and Rhino ALL NEW!
posts.excerpt: New York fully designed (minus some stations), that was some work!
posts.body:
# We have a website! And what a shitshow :D

This is the first post here, hurray! But Im not going to go all teary eyed on it.
Simple, I have been working quite a while on this.
5 days to be precise :D

It's truly remarkable how insanely fast modern AI can do things.

From just an idea a week ago I already have New York fully running in UE, all in a few days.

But this is not to say there wasn't a complete bullshittery going on.

But I have noticed why.

## The prompt is everything

Initially I used Grokbot, which is already a big mistake because Claude Code is SO MUCH better. Light years away.

I still use Grokbot for my local PC stuff. Very good at that and nicely integrated. But for coding, Claude is truly unbeaten.

However, due to that initial prompt that basically just moved the entire OLD way of how New York was built into UE, I was stuck with 20 year old lighting, scripts, and stations.

I only noticed this once I wanted to add better lighting in the nebulas, and it was virtually impossible to get right.

After many thousands of AI tokens I literally told Claude "Do this thing, and forget everything in the project so far, old tech, redo it entirely from scratch with UE" and then it worked.

So I ran an audit on the code and it basically told me it all sucks :D

Thus, the last 3 days I was pretty much busy having it rewrite the entire system from scratch with new coding methods.

## Current Status

Enough bullshitting. We got it going. The Defender is (mostly) done, Rhino is entirely rebuilt (see Screenshot), bunch of stations are here and NPCs fly around.

Concept:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-18-d5156cc7-ddd2-4f27-954c-f856c1827a8a-mve2toxh.jpg)

Ingame:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-18-cargo0-00-hero-mve4kihn.jpg)

![](images/uploads/2026-10-18-cargo1-09-engines-mve4krcg.jpg)

![](images/uploads/2026-10-18-cargo0-08-police-mve4lk6v.jpg)



As you can tell it's not exactly the concept, but I actually like how it came out. Considering this took the AI about 20min to do :D

Also notice the new effect, when your cargo is above 60% it visibly carries cargo in the midsection.

Defender Concept:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-18-927e85be-d4ac-4231-8493-1b7d37a0e806-mve2veru.jpg)


Ingame:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VKFcgTnifbc

This video is already old tho, lots of stuff missing.

Nebulas look fire, mines work, and currently I am building the planet surface for Pittsburgh which will be another shitshow, but here we are :D

-Alex
